name: Midwit
core: Low and high IQ reach the same simple conclusion; the middle overcomplicates it.
slots: simple take, held by the dumb/low end
overwrought, overcomplicated take of the midwit middle
same simple take again, held by the genius end
avoid: jokes without a simple-vs-overthinking contrast; plain escalating tiers

name: You Guys Are Getting Paid?
core: Someone discovers others earn far more than them, reacting in shocked realization.
slots: first person's inflated pay or benefit, stated incredulously
second person's smaller but still surprising amount
the shocked punchline: you guys are getting paid?
avoid: generic surprise without unequal compensation or hidden perks

name: Mini Keanu Reeves
core: Tiny wholesome Keanu Reeves patiently waiting with a gentle, hopeful expression.
slots: situation of waiting or wanting attention
the small sweet thing you want to share or do
avoid: angry, aggressive, or cynical jokes; Keanu as tough action hero

name: Minor Mistake Marvin
core: A tiny mistake done with calm confidence, then the absurd consequence is revealed.
slots: innocent action done by the careless person
wrong place or twist that reveals the mistake
avoid: deliberate evil or big disasters; jokes without a small blunder

name: Shut Up and Take My Money!
core: Instantly sold on a product or idea; eager to hand over cash.
aliases: shut up and take my money
avoid: disliking or rejecting a product; unwilling consumers

name: One Does Not Simply Walk into Mordor
core: Boromir warns that some task is far harder than people assume.
slots: an task that sounds easy but is actually hard
avoid: things that are genuinely easy; unrelated reactions or complaints

name: Matrix Morpheus
core: Morpheus offers a mind-blowing reframing of something you thought you knew.
avoid: plain jokes with no revelation; mundane complaints

name: Woman Holding Dog's Mouth
core: One party excitedly pitches while another covers the mouth of the one who knows it won't work.
slots: the person speaking or pitching the idea
the excited audience, receiving the pitch
the person silenced who knows the truth
avoid: consensual agreements; scenes without suppressed knowledge or inconvenient truth

name: I Guarantee It
core: Salesman confidently promises a result and guarantees it.
slots: i'm going to promise you a pleasing outcome
aliases: you're gonna like the way you look
avoid: doubtful or uncertain statements; non-promise punchlines

name: Guy Hammering Nails Into Sand
core: Someone futilely hammers nails into sand, trying to build with inadequate material.
slots: the hammerer: person or tool attempting the task
the nails or the tool being used
the sand: the thing too fluid or formless to work with
avoid: tasks that succeed; jokes with no futility or mismatch

name: So I Got That Goin' For Me, Which is Nice
core: Resigned silver lining after listing misfortunes: at least one thing goes right.
slots: so I got that goin' for me, which is nice
aliases: so i got that goin for me
avoid: genuine boasting; big wins without sarcastic undertone

name: What the Hell is This?
core: Two things combine into an ugly hybrid, then someone asks what this is.
avoid: single objects; hybrids that are good or desirable

name: I Have No Idea What I'm Doing
core: Dog confesses to total cluelessness while doing something anyway.
aliases: i have no idea what i'm doing
avoid: expertise, confidence, or competence jokes

name: No Take, Only Throw
core: Someone is happy to receive but refuses to give back.
slots: request or plea for them to give
the refusal to give or return
the rule: only taking is allowed
avoid: generosity or fair exchange; jokes with no one-sided taking

name: Overly Attached Girlfriend
core: Clingy girlfriend reveals creepy obsessive behavior with a cheerful, wide-eyed smile.
slots: something seemingly innocent she knows or did
the creepy way she knows it
avoid: healthy romance or wholesome affection; generic jokes

name: That Would Be Great
core: Passive-aggressive boss casually dumps extra work with fake politeness.
slots: yeah... (opener, setup of the unreasonable request)
that'd be great (the ask or demand)
avoid: actual friendly requests; non-workplace or non-demanding situations

name: An Older Code Sir, But It Checks Out
core: Acknowledging something is old or outdated, but still valid or working.
avoid: new things; items that are old and worthless

name: Oprah You Get a Car
core: Oprah excitedly gives everyone the same thing, you get X, you get X.
slots: you get a (thing), everyone gets one
avoid: scarcity, withholding, or exclusive prizes

name: Panik Kalm Panik
core: Panic, then false reassurance, then even worse panic.
slots: reveal that makes it worse, panic
avoid: simple reactions with no reversal; things that stay calm

name: Push it somewhere else Patrick
core: SpongeBob suggests an idea; Patrick says to push it somewhere else.
slots: the rejection or deflection of the problem to somewhere else
avoid: agreeable or accepted proposals

name: Perfection
core: Repeatedly offered wrong versions until the right one finally arrives and is declared perfect.
slots: the demand, preferring the real one
avoid: single-step reveals; jokes with no wrong then right options

name: Persian Cat Room Guardian
core: Persian cat guards the room, glaring at anyone disturbing its peace.
slots: situation that causes an annoyed or angry reaction
what is disturbing or angering you
avoid: cute pleasant moments; excited or happy reactions

name: Philosoraptor
core: A pseudo-deep shower thought or logical paradox posed as a rhetorical question.
slots: premise or setup of the thought
avoid: jokes without a logical twist or contradiction

name: Is This a Pigeon?
core: Someone mistakes one thing for another, asking if it is that.
avoid: correct identification; non-mistaken, obvious comparisons

name: Tuxedo Winnie the Pooh
core: Plain version of something versus a fancy, pretentious rewording of the same thing.
slots: the fancy, sophisticated phrasing of the same thing
avoid: Genuine rejection of a bad option for a different good one

name: Mother Ignoring Kid Drowning In A Pool
core: Caretaker ignores a real crisis while attending to a trivial, more visible concern.
slots: the thing getting attention (the other kid)
the negligent party who ignores the crisis
avoid: Jokes without a neglected problem versus a favored one

name: Too Confusing, Too Extreme
core: Mocks a mundane thing as 'too confusing, too extreme' in a political-slogan style.
slots: the mundane thing being called too confusing and extreme
avoid: Serious complaints, dialogue, or multi-part setups

name: Phoebe Teaching Joey
core: Phoebe slowly repeats words to an uncomprehending Joey, who finally gets it wrong.
avoid: Anything without a slow explanation and a misunderstanding payoff

name: Unpopular opinion puffin
core: Admits a mildly contrarian opinion about something widely loved.
avoid: Popular opinions, outrage, or non-opinion observations

name: Oh, Is That What We're Going to Do Today?
core: A calm character sarcastically asks if today's plan is to start a fight.
slots: sarcastic 'oh, is that what we're going to do today?'
the confrontational thing being implied or proposed
aliases: oh is that what we're going to do today
avoid: Non-confrontational jokes or genuine questions

name: I Immediately Regret This Decision!
core: Instantly regretting a decision right after making it.
slots: the regret line or the bad decision
avoid: Long-term regrets or decisions that turn out fine

name: Pepperidge Farm Remembers
core: Old-timey nostalgia: Pepperidge Farm 'remembers' something from the past, asked of the audience.
slots: the nostalgic thing or question about the past
'pepperidge farm remembers' or a tweak of it
avoid: Current events or things with no past reference

name: Scooby Doo Reveal
core: Unmasking a villain reveals it's the protagonist, who's been the problem all along.
slots: the masked villain or apparent culprit
aliases: let's see who this really is
avoid: Jokes where the culprit isn't surprising or self-inflicted

name: Anakin and Padme Change the World For the Better
core: One naive character proposes a plan; the other's 'right?' hides dread and doubt.
slots: the same hopeful follow-up repeated, unanswered
avoid: Genuine agreement or plans that actually work out

name: Roll Safe
core: Smug 'can't have a problem if you avoid it' pseudo-genius logic.
avoid: Sincere intelligence or logic that actually holds up

name: Sad Joe Biden
core: Sad politician who doesn't think you'll vote; label him and add a jab.
slots: 'doesn't think you'll...' with a thing you'll fail to do
avoid: Cheerful or non-expectation jokes

name: Sad John Boehner
core: Sad politician who doesn't think you'll vote; label him and add a jab.
slots: 'doesn't think you'll...' with a thing you'll fail to do
avoid: Cheerful or non-expectation jokes

name: Sad George Bush
core: Sad politician who doesn't think you'll vote; label him and add a jab.
slots: 'doesn't think you'll...' with a thing you'll fail to do
avoid: Cheerful or non-expectation jokes

name: Sad Bill Clinton
core: Sad politician who doesn't think you'll vote; label him and add a jab.
slots: 'doesn't think you'll...' with a thing you'll fail to do
avoid: Cheerful or non-expectation jokes

name: Sad Barack Obama
core: Sad politician who doesn't think you'll vote; label him and add a jab.
slots: 'doesn't think you'll...' with a thing you'll fail to do
avoid: Cheerful or non-expectation jokes

name: Feels Bad Man
core: Pepe the frog expressing melancholy, defeat, or 'feels bad man'.
slots: the sad situation, ending in 'feels bad man'
avoid: Happy moments or angry rants

name: Salt Bae
core: Flamboyantly adding a finishing touch to something with excessive flair.
slots: the thing being garnished or flourished
avoid: Jokes lacking an added flourish or finishing touch

name: They're The Same Picture
core: Pointing at two things claiming they're identical, while a third labels the sameness.
slots: first thing claimed to be the same
second thing claimed to be the same
the shared label that makes them equivalent
avoid: Contrasts or differences between things

name: Sarcastic Bear
core: Sarcastic mock apology for not knowing or doing something obvious.
slots: the snarky reason behind the apology
avoid: Sincere apologies or friendly advice

name: Say the Line, Bart!
core: A character is goaded into saying a signature catchphrase they're known for.
slots: the prompt urging someone to say their catchphrase
the signature line or cliché response
avoid: Generic dialogue without a catchphrase payoff

name: Scumbag Brain
core: Brain betrays you by remembering useless things and forgetting what matters.
slots: the unhelpful thing the brain does
the betraying twist or what it forgets
avoid: Complaints about other people or events

name: Sudden Clarity Clarence
core: Stoned sudden realization that recontextualizes a past event.
slots: the revelation recontextualizing a past experience
avoid: Planned logic or obvious conclusions

name: Inhaling Seagull
core: Seagull inhales dramatically; lyrics get screamed out, split by the inhale.
slots: the first part of a word or lyric
avoid: Quiet jokes or non-screaming, non-lyric punchlines

name: Sealed Fate
core: Something minor goes wrong and you realize doom is certain and imminent.
slots: the minor mishap or action that sets things off
the grim realization that consequences are unavoidable
avoid: Positive outcomes, long-term problems, or situations with no looming consequence.

name: Skeptical Third World Kid
core: Skeptical kid doubts a claim, answering a statement with a sarcastic, incredulous question.
slots: the claim or statement being doubted
avoid: Genuine praise, earnest excitement, or jokes without a doubted claim.

name: Super Cool Ski Instructor
core: Cool ski instructor delivers an ominous, ironic warning: 'you're gonna have a bad time'.
slots: the warning about a bad outcome, usually ending 'you're gonna have a bad time'
aliases: you're gonna have a bad time
avoid: Genuinely good outcomes or serious, non-ironic warnings.

name: Will Smith Slapping Chris Rock
core: One thing violently smacks down another; label the aggressor and the victim.
slots: the victim, usually the relatable person or happy state
the aggressor that ruins it, label for the slapper
avoid: Gentle conflicts or non-violent, mutual disagreements.

name: Skeptical Snake
core: Snake recoils with suspicion when something previously safe turns suspicious or alarming.
slots: the setup that seemed safe or checked
avoid: Confident wins or enthusiastic approval without a twist of suspicion.

name: Seal of Approval
core: Seal gives approval or delight at a small satisfying success or clean result.
avoid: Failures, disappointment, or negative outcomes.

name: I Would Be So Happy
core: Wishful statement: 'if I could X, I would be so happy', absurdly emotional.
slots: the 'I would be so happy' payoff, often meta
avoid: Sarcasm, anger, or wishes that aren't heartfelt.

name: So Hot Right Now
core: Mugatu's deadpan declaration that something is 'so hot right now', mocking fads.
avoid: Things that are unpopular, ignored, or genuinely timeless.

name: No Soup for You
core: Denying someone something they want, shouted with 'No soup for you!'
avoid: Generous offers or gentle refusals.

name: This is Sparta!
core: Leonidas screams a declaration, then kicks someone into a pit, in an over-the-top manner.
slots: the dramatic punchline, usually the thing being proclaimed
avoid: Quiet, understated, or low-energy jokes.

name: Spider-Man Pointing at Spider-Man
core: Two identical Spider-Men point at each other, showing mutual resemblance or accusation.
slots: one party doing or being the thing
the other party doing or being the same thing
avoid: Jokes about differences, solitary subjects, or more than two parties.

name: Fake Spirit Halloween Costume
core: Parody costume package: a label for a person plus a list of absurdly minimal 'Includes' items.
slots: first included item, often a letdown
avoid: Real costume ideas or jokes without a list of items.
